newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES END A SHADE HIGHER AT 19.75 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES END A SHADE HIGHER AT 19.75 PCT.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates ended at 19.75 percent on Tuesday, up from Monday's close of 19.625 percent, but traders stil saw the market in a range.
"Overnight rates traded in the same narrow range they did for the last week," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.
On Tuesday, overnight rates traded between 19.625 and 19.875 perrcent, with most deals struck at 19.75 percent in a very liquid market.
Traders said earlier money influx from other European emerging markets was probably the main reason behind current low overnight rates on the interbank market.
